decisions_log.decision: Use ISO 8601 dates with milliseconds (.000Z suffix) in changelog.json so the stored value round-trips exactly through Date.toISOString().
decisions_log.rationale: Date.prototype.toISOString() always emits the .000Z suffix for UTC midnight dates; matching that format avoids a test mismatch and keeps the JSON unambiguously machine-readable.

decisions_log.decision: Only escape &, <, and > in the XML escaping helper — not ' or ".
decisions_log.rationale: Single quotes and double quotes are only special inside attribute values in XML. Escaping them in element content is unnecessary and makes the raw text harder to read. Using the minimal correct set avoids spurious entity encoding in the feed body.

decisions_log.decision: Use @jest-environment node for the Route Handler test file.
decisions_log.rationale: The Web API Response global is available in Node.js v18+ but not exposed by jest-environment-jsdom. Since the route handler is server-side code (not a browser component), the node test environment is the correct choice and avoids a polyfill dependency.

decisions_log.decision: Use native Web API Response (not NextResponse) in the route handler.
decisions_log.rationale: Next.js App Router Route Handlers support the standard Web API Response. Using it avoids importing from next/server and keeps the handler self-contained and easily testable without the Next.js runtime.
